'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Calvin Kurten LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Calvin Kurten]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
